## Script Summary 
- Removes lowly expressed genes from the  RNAseq data  

- Set rownames to our gene symbols in an informed matter using variation

- Applies filtering to all TCGA projects

- Saves processed SummarizedExperiments

## Data Loading
Load in SummarizedExperiment RDS objects and define output directory
```{r data loading}
#Path where the summarized experiment objects you are updating are located
se_directory <- file.path(TCGA, "RNAseq/processed_data/all/")
#Path to directory you want to output to
output_directory <- file.path(PATH, "data/RNAseq/processed_SummarizedExperiments")
```

Here we load in a single TCGA project (BRCA) to show the workflow
```{r Load in BRCA object}
BRCA <- readRDS(file.path(TCGA,"RNAseq/processed_data/all/TCGA-BRCA_RNAseq.rds"))
```

## Quality Control

### Filtering Lowly Expressed Genes
I have gone back and forth on the best approach to filtering lowly expressed genes, such as utilizing edgeR's `filterbyExpr()` function. Given our analysis utilized `DESeq2` for differential analysis, I have decided to apply minimal filtering due to `DESeq2` performing internal filtering when extracting results with the `results()` function. 

Therefore we only remove genes that do not have at least 5 counts across 10 samples. This still removes a large number of genes, but provides a balance between computational efficiency and retaining as much information as possible for downstream analyses. 
```{r}
keep <- rowSums(cpm(assay(BRCA,"unstranded")) > 0) >= 10
BRCA_filtered <- BRCA[keep, ]

# Print the number of removed lowly expressed genes
cat("Number of removed lowly expressed genes:", sum(!keep), "\n")
cat("Number of remaining genes:", sum(keep), "\n")
```



Visualizes the distribution of gene counts before and after filtering to see the impact of removing lowly expressed genes.
```{r}
# Distribution of counts before filtering
counts_before <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(BRCA)
row_sums_before <- rowSums(counts_before)

p_before <- ggplot2::ggplot(data.frame(counts = row_sums_before + 1), aes(x = counts)) +
            ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "blue", alpha = 0.7) +
            ggplot2::scale_x_log10() +
            ggplot2::ggtitle("Gene Counts Distribution Before Filtering")

# Distribution of counts after filtering
counts_after <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(BRCA_filtered)
row_sums_after <- rowSums(counts_after)

p_after <- ggplot2::ggplot(data.frame(counts = row_sums_after + 1), aes(x = counts)) +
           ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "green", alpha = 0.7) +
           ggplot2::scale_x_log10() +
           ggplot2::ggtitle("Gene Counts Distribution After Filtering")

gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_before, p_after, ncol = 2)
```

## Removing Duplicate Gene Names
One issue we have here is that our rows are set as ENSEMBL ids, where their associated gene names may contain duplicates across our entire data set. This is troublesome for downstream analyses that rely on gene symbols such as gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA). Our approach here is to calculate the variance of each ensembl ID (using log transformed and normalized counts), then retain the duplicate that contains the HIGHEST variance. There are other potential approach to this, but genes with high variance are more likely to contain differential expression across samples (at least thats what I think!). 

```{r}
# Calculate variance for each gene
gene_variances <- rowVars(assay(BRCA_filtered,"DESeq2_log"))

# Add variance to rowData
rowData(BRCA_filtered)$variance <- gene_variances

# Extract gene symbols
gene_symbols <- rowData(BRCA_filtered)$gene_name

# Identify duplicated gene symbols
duplicated_symbols <- gene_symbols[duplicated(gene_symbols)]

# Number of duplicated gene symbols
num_duplicated_genes <- length(unique(duplicated_symbols))
cat("Number of duplicated gene symbols:", num_duplicated_genes, "\n")

# Create a data frame with gene information
gene_info <- data.frame(
  ensembl_id = rownames(BRCA_filtered),
  gene_symbol = gene_symbols,
  variance = gene_variances,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Subset to duplicated genes
duplicated_gene_info <- gene_info %>% filter(gene_symbol %in% duplicated_symbols)

reactable::reactable(duplicated_gene_info, searchable = TRUE)

# For each gene symbol, keep the Ensembl ID with the highest variance
gene_info_retained <- gene_info %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = variance, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Number of duplicates removed
duplicates_removed <- nrow(gene_info) - nrow(gene_info_retained)
cat("Number of duplicates removed:", duplicates_removed, "\n")

# Mark genes as retained or not
gene_info$Status <- ifelse(gene_info$ensembl_id %in% gene_info_retained$ensembl_id, "Retained", "Filtered Out")

duplicated_gene_info <- gene_info %>% filter(gene_symbol %in% duplicated_symbols)
duplicated_gene_info_retained <- duplicated_gene_info %>% filter(Status == "Retained")

# Plot variances of duplicated genes, coloring retained genes differently
ggplot(duplicated_gene_info, aes(x = variance, fill = Status)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") +
  ggtitle("Variance Distribution of Duplicated Genes (All)") +
  xlab("Variance") +
  ylab("Number of Ensembl IDs") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Retained" = "lightgreen", "Filtered Out" = "skyblue")) +
  theme_minimal()

```




```{r}
# Get Ensembl IDs to keep
ensembl_ids_to_keep <- gene_info_retained$ensembl_id

# Subset BRCA_filtered
BRCA_filtered_unique <- BRCA_filtered[ensembl_ids_to_keep, ]

# Update rownames to gene symbols
rownames(BRCA_filtered_unique) <- rowData(BRCA_filtered_unique)$gene_symbol

# Number of genes before and after duplicate removal
cat("Number of genes before removing duplicates:", nrow(BRCA_filtered), "\n")
cat("Number of genes after removing duplicates:", nrow(BRCA_filtered_unique), "\n")
```



# Apply Filtering to all TCGA projects
This section applies the filtering steps to all RNAseq SummarizedExperiment objects 
```{r filter SEs}
# Create a list of all files ending in .rds in se_directory
file_list <- list.files(path = se_directory, pattern = "*.rds", full.names = TRUE)

# Initialize a data frame to store the summary information
summary_table <- data.frame(Project = character(),
                            RemovedGenes = numeric(),
                            RemainingGenes = numeric(),
                            RemovedDuplicates = numeric(),
                            stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Loop through each file
for (file_path in file_list) {
  cat("Filtering and saving ", file_path, "\n")
  
  # Read the SummarizedExperiment object
  se_obj <- readRDS(file_path)
  
  # Filter lowly expressed genes (using your existing criteria)
  keep <- rowSums(cpm(assay(se_obj, "unstranded")) > 0) >= 10
  se_obj_filtered <- se_obj[keep, ]
  
  # Track the number of removed and remaining genes
  removed_genes <- sum(!keep)
  remaining_genes <- sum(keep)
  
  # Calculate variance for each gene (Ensembl ID)
  gene_variances <- rowVars(assay(se_obj_filtered, "DESeq2_log"))
  rowData(se_obj_filtered)$variance <- gene_variances
  
  # Extract gene symbols
  gene_symbols <- rowData(se_obj_filtered)$gene_name
  
  # Create a data frame with Ensembl IDs, gene symbols, and variances
  gene_info <- data.frame(
    ensembl_id = rownames(se_obj_filtered),
    gene_symbol = gene_symbols,
    variance = gene_variances,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # For genes with duplicates, keep the one with the highest variance
# For genes with duplicates, keep the one with the highest variance
  gene_info_retained <- gene_info %>%
    group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = variance, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Get the Ensembl IDs to keep
  ensembl_ids_to_keep <- gene_info_retained$ensembl_id
  
  # Calculate the number of duplicates removed
  removed_duplicates <- nrow(gene_info) - nrow(gene_info_retained)
  
  # Subset the SummarizedExperiment object
  se_obj_filtered <- se_obj_filtered[ensembl_ids_to_keep, ]
  
  # Update rownames to gene symbols
  rownames(se_obj_filtered) <- rowData(se_obj_filtered)$gene_name
  
  # Update remaining genes count
  remaining_genes <- nrow(se_obj_filtered)
  
  # Append the information to the summary table
  project_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file_path))
  summary_table <- rbind(summary_table, data.frame(Project = project_name,
                                                   RemovedGenes = removed_genes,
                                                   RemovedDuplicates = removed_duplicates,
                                                   RemainingGenes = remaining_genes))
  
  # Ensure sample order still matches (should not be an issue)
  if (identical(colnames(se_obj), colnames(se_obj_filtered)) & !anyDuplicated(rownames(se_obj_filtered))) {
    # Save output
    output_path <- file.path(output_directory, basename(file_path))
    saveRDS(se_obj_filtered, output_path)
    
    cat("Saved filtered SummarizedExperiment to", output_path, "\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("Cannot create new SummarizedExperiment: Samples/Genes are mismatched\n")
  }
}

# Print the summary table
reactable::reactable(summary_table, searchable = TRUE, resizable = TRUE)
```
